class.name: OcgGceMakeelips2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Elips2d`. Supported constructions include: - ellipse from major axis (or local 2D coordinate system) and radii; - ellipse from center and two points.
class.description: ! This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Elips2d`. ! Supported constructions include: ! - ellipse from major axis (or local 2D coordinate system) and radii; ! - ellipse from center and two points.

method.name: from_gp_Ax22d_const_ref_double_double
method.description: Axis defines the Xaxis and Yaxis of the ellipse which defines the origin and the sense of parametrization. Creates an ellipse with the AxisPlacement the major and the minor radius. The location of Axis is the center of the ellipse. It is possible to create an ellipse with MajorRadius = MinorRadius.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates an ellipse from center and two points.

method.name: from_gp_Ax2d_const_ref_double_double_bool
method.description: Creates an ellipse with the major axis, the major and the minor radius. The location of the MajorAxis is the center of the ellipse. The sense of parametrization is given by Sense. It is possible to create an ellipse with MajorRadius = MinorRadius.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed ellipse. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no ellipse is constructed.

method.name: Operator
method.description: Alias for Value() returning a copy.
